name: Floor & Decor Holdings
plan: NO POSITION. Price gate: alert below $42 (~20x adjusted EPS, below the May low). Re-open only on two consecutive quarters of POSITIVE comparable store sales - never on an EPS beat.
catalyst: Q3 2026 print 2026-10-28 (verified) - clean 12-week window, but no mispricing to enter. Housing/existing-home-sales turn is the only real fix and is not company-controlled.
kill_triggers: comps remain negative through FY26 as guided
adjusted EPS declines y/y in any quarter
FY27 guide again separates GAAP from adjusted by >10%
edge_explainer: The STALE flag was right that the screen data was old, and re-pulling it makes the name worse. FND printed Q2 on 2026-07-30 and the stock rose on 'improved EPS outlook': GAAP diluted EPS $0.89 (+53.4%) versus adjusted diluted EPS $0.58 (FLAT), gross margin 48.2% (+430bps) - while comparable store sales fell 2.1%. The $0.31/share gap is a one-time IEEPA customs-duty refund, and it is the entire margin expansion. FY26 guidance carries the same shape (GAAP $2.20-2.45 vs adjusted $1.88-2.13, comps guided -4.0% to flat, with ~$65M of sales and $0.08 of EPS from a 53rd week). This is a textbook takeaway-vs-data divergence and it is exactly how the screen was fooled: consensus was marked UP (FY26 $1.903 -> $1.971, 4 up-revisions in 7 days) on a non-recurring refund plus an extra fiscal week, which any de-rate-vs-derailment test reads as the HUBS/CTSH winner pattern. On adjusted FY26 EPS of ~$2.005 the stock is 28.5x (29.7x ex-53rd-week) with negative comps - a bubble multiple still normalising, not an own-history discount. Path is late: +33.6% off a 77-day-old low.
top_unverifiable: The exact dollar amount of the IEEPA refund was not read from the 10-Q; it is inferred from the $0.31 GAAP-vs-adjusted spread (~$33M). Whether any portion recurs in H2 is unknown.
screen_defect: When GAAP and adjusted guidance diverge by >10%, run the estimate-trajectory test on the ADJUSTED line and flag the delta's cause - otherwise the screen buys tariff refunds.
